selection_rationale: Prefer parameterized single-record tasks with a state-based task oracle, short UI paths, and fields that support visible, reviewable mutations.

cases.visibility_check: Open the event in the calendar UI and have a reviewer confirm the changed field is visible.
cases.selection_reason: Single structured event with title, date, duration, and description; the AndroidWorld task guide documents its Events table and task oracle.

cases.visibility_check: Open the expense list or detail and have a reviewer confirm the changed field is visible.
cases.selection_reason: Single structured financial record makes wrong-value and missing-record faults straightforward to define. Keep runs on a disposable emulator.

cases.visibility_check: Open the recipe detail and have a reviewer confirm the target field is visible.
cases.selection_reason: AndroidWorld exposes a structured recipe row with several independently mutable fields and a task-specific state oracle.

cases.visibility_check: Open the contact card and confirm the changed name or number is visible.
cases.selection_reason: Useful cross-store check beyond app-owned SQLite; keep only if the emulator's Contacts provider can be mutated and restored safely.

cases.visibility_check: Open the note in Markor and confirm the content or name fault is visible.
cases.selection_reason: Adds a file-backed state reader and realistic note-content checks; mutations must preserve the app's filename and encoding rules.

cases.visibility_check: Use only a disposable emulator with no external SMS transport; inspect the local conversation.
cases.selection_reason: Strong wrong-recipient and wrong-body checks, but excluded from the default suite until emulator-only delivery is verified.
